name: Lambda
description: The lambda.7 by Force Dimension is a 7-degree-of-freedom haptic master interface combining a delta-based parallel kinematic structure for 3-DOF translation with a motorized serial wrist and active pinch gripper, providing full 7-DOF position sensing and active force, torque, and grasping feedback. Compared to desktop haptic devices, its slim profile and asymmetric workspace are engineered specifically for side-by-side bimanual mounting inside surgical consoles without mechanical interference between the operator's hands. It is used as an OEM master controller in commercial surgical platforms such as the [RIVERFIELD Saroa](/robot/riverfield_saroa) surgical system.
